summary: Retained receipt 905d729b2a284c93bbbedd3c3a307ca8 (completed, exit 0) closed the two remaining evidence gaps with all fifteen comparisons complete and satisfied: the invocation issued with a context that never expires stayed pending through a 2000 ms window with leader 1 stable and its payload uncommitted (indices 11, 12), and after the forced leader change the same still-pending invocation was admitted with no error at 3621 ms (index 30, pending false, leader 2) and its payload was then committed on all three nodes (index 31) — so the harmed interval is the wait without any error signal, not lost work. The interpretation for that experiment is attributed with all four lineage receipts (joint history; witnesses agree at indices 7/8/9, 11-12, 14-15, 17/22, 28-29, 30-31), the observations are recorded as durable knowledge with receipt indices, and the two limitations they close were replaced by narrower ones (the retained releases are now a caller deadline and a leader change; node stop is no longer claimed). In addition, a successor experiment is submitted that closes the remaining variant limitation: the same gate is exercised through the administrative entry point, proposing a configuration change (add node 9) through the re-added voter during the blocked window, with two new comparisons on uniquely named events; the harness was verified locally in the scratch copy, where that proposal likewise returned false at 800 ms with leader 1 stable and no node applied it (present false).
